name: SuperBot
description:
Search and review your SuperBot support conversations, identify triage candidates, and check what your AI already knows. Get support metrics with CSAT sample sizes and source-linked conversation insights. With your approval, add a new trained answer to improve future visitor conversations.

Six read-only tools and one separate training-write tool are scoped to the workspace you authorize. The connector cannot refund orders, send customer messages, run campaigns, or access another workspace. Open and pending conversations are clearly distinguished from confirmed escalations. Long transcripts are bounded and include a link to the complete conversation. Requires a SuperBot account and support data in the connected workspace and is designed for merchant teams, not shoppers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SuperBot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SuperBot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://superbotapp.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SuperBot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SuperBot provides these MCP tools: add_trained_answer, fetch, get_support_overview, list_recent_conversations, list_unanswered_questions, search, and search_knowledge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SuperBot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to SuperBot in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
SuperBot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SuperBot is developed by AI Understanding (SuperBot). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
